description:
Render closed vocabularies in human output through their wire tokens instead of lowercased `Debug` names.

## Background

Human output formats vocabularies through `Debug`, for example `format!("{:?}").to_lowercase()`, which prints `inprogress` for the `in_progress` state: `crates/jit/src/main.rs:2068,2069,2091,4472,4820,6422,6466,6507,6555,6600,6754,6755`, `commands/bulk_update.rs:490` and `commands/gate.rs:13` (`{status:?}`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No human render in `main.rs`, `commands/bulk_update.rs` or `commands/gate.rs` formats a closed vocabulary through `Debug`; each uses `as_str` or `Display`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Human output shows the same tokens as JSON output.
title: Human output renders vocabulary tokens, not Debug names
